name: Tameeni Insurance
verdict: Tameeni is a subsidiary of Rasan Information Technology, a Saudi fintech listed on the Saudi Exchange (Tadawul: 8313). Nothing found.
note: Saudi insurance-comparison platform; front of several Saudi Pro League shirts in 2026/27, including Al-Hazem, and a badge on the right chest of Al-Taawoun's 2026-27 home shirt (club announcement 2025-08-29; visible in the club's kit-launch photography, issue #377). Owner traced to Rasan Information Technology, a Saudi joint-stock company listed on the Saudi Exchange (listed 2024-06-13); founded by the Alfallaj brothers. No state body or fund found in the chain, and no court, regulator, UN-body or major-NGO human-rights finding against the company found (searched 2026-10-03). Vehicle-level caveat: Rasan's IPO prospectus shows its two largest post-offering lines (13.06% + 4.49%) held by custodian vehicles for Impact46-managed venture funds whose investors are undisclosed, and Saudi state fund-of-funds SVC publicly invested $30m in Impact46's Fund III (Saudi Press Agency, 2 October 2023) — so an indirect state-fund stake behind Rasan's largest line at IPO time cannot be excluded; Impact46 announced its full exit from Rasan on 2025-03-13.
